how: Treat marker changes as bidirectional contract changes. Validate render and extract together and add focused tests for any new marker behavior.
how_not: Do not make rendering look nicer by silently weakening extraction fidelity or by introducing marker semantics that cannot roundtrip safely.
title: Keep template markers reversible at the document boundary
what: Template marker features should preserve the reversible SLDB document contract unless a task explicitly defines a lossy representation.
when: Apply this pill when changing marker families, render/extract behavior, standalone markers, or template invariant logic.
why: Rendered values that cannot extract back into the same structured payload break the core promise that structured Markdown remains a safe source artifact.
